title: feat: Team plan needs a Max 20x equivalent tier for power users
body:
## Problem

The Team plan currently offers two seat types:
- **Standard** (1.25x Pro usage)
- **Premium** (6.25x Pro usage)

For power users (CTOs, tech leads, senior devs) who rely heavily on Claude Code CLI for agentic coding workflows, **6.25x is not enough**. We currently use **Max 20x** individually, which means we can't move to Team without a significant downgrade in usage capacity.

## Current workaround (bad)

- Keep individual Max 20x accounts for power users
- Create a separate Team org for the rest of the team
- Result: two completely separate accounts, no SSO unification, no shared projects between power users and the team

## Proposed solution

Add a **Premium 20x** (or "Ultra") seat type to the Team plan, equivalent to the individual Max 20x usage tier. This would allow organizations to:

1. Keep all members under one org with centralized billing and SSO
2. Assign different usage tiers based on role (Standard for marketing/product, Premium for devs, Ultra/20x for tech leads)
3. Avoid the split-brain problem of individual + team accounts

## Why this matters

Organizations adopting Claude Code for their engineering teams have power users who push the limits daily. Forcing them to choose between team collaboration features (SSO, shared projects, admin controls) and adequate usage capacity is a blocker for enterprise adoption.

## Context

- Team size: 5-15 people
- Power users: 2-3 (CTO + tech leads using Claude Code CLI all day)
- Regular users: 5-10 (devs, product, marketing)
- Current setup: individual Max 20x accounts, evaluating Team plan
